subject: POC Plan & Success Criteria — Re-baseline after scope change
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Park <john.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Plan & Success Criteria — Redwood POC (Nimbus) — Post-call recap

Hi John,

Thanks for the call earlier — quick recap and next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial:

Summary we agreed on call:
- Scope: Retrieval + classification for customer support routing (primary).
- Success criteria (baseline):
  1) 95th percentile latency < 200ms for 1kQPS-ish simulation;
  2) Classification accuracy >= 92% on your labeled eval set;
  3) Seamless integration via our API and a demo app by end of trial.
- Timeline: data ingest and test set delivery by 5/14, infra + config by 5/18, evaluation complete by 5/21.
- Ownership: John (Nimbus) to provide data and acceptance criteria; Marissa (Redwood) to own SOW and coordination; Dev (Redwood) SE to own infra/config.

Attachments: POC-SOW-v1.pdf (draft SOW + deliverables). Please review and flag any changes.

Next steps:
1) John to confirm test set delivery date (5/14 target).
2) I will circulate SOW v1 and proposed kickoff slot for 5/19.
3) Dev — can you validate infra/runbook estimates once John confirms data shape?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this spun up.

Best,
Marissa
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0127

From: John Park <john.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 17:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC Plan & Success Criteria — Redwood POC (Nimbus) — Post-call recap

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A couple of asks from our side after huddling with the product team: 

1) Add a reranking use case to the POC. We want to validate a search + rerank flow for knowledge base answers; outcome metric will be NDCG@10 (we're aiming for >= 0.90). This will be in addition to the classification use case.

2) Timeline: the data engineering team needs a little more time to produce the reranking dataset (combined queries + human judgments). Can we push the evaluation completion date to 5/28? Data delivery to you would be 5/18.

3) Please confirm how this scope change impacts compute needs and whether it changes the cost profile or credits for the trial. Also include any additional support days required from your SE team.

Technical owner on our side will be Alex Mercer (cc'd). We'll also loop Legal for an SOW amendment if needed.

--
John Park
Head of Product, Nimbus Analytics
john.park@nimbus-analytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Park <john.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Plan & Success Criteria — Re: scope change (reranking)

John — appreciate the heads up and the specific metric (NDCG@10). We can absolutely add reranking to the scope; I want to call out a few impacts and propose a re-baseline so expectations are locked.

Impact summary:
- Timeline: move evaluation cutoff to 2026-05-28 to accommodate data delivery on 5/18 + SE setup.
- Technical effort: SE time to build the reranking evaluation harness and data transforms (estimated 2 days).
- Cost/credits: rough estimate (Dev to confirm) is +~30% additional GPU hours for the trial window due to larger sequence lengths during rerank scoring.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Dev — can you confirm the +30% number and list any config changes (quantization, batching) we should include in SOW v1.1?
2) I'll draft POC-SOW-v1.1 reflecting the extra use case, timeline, and SE days and re-circulate for sign-off.
3) Rafael — can you approve a small trial credit or extension to cover the delta while we evaluate? I expect it to be modest but helpful for procurement.

If that sounds good I'll update the SOW and aim to get the amended doc to Nimbus Legal by 5/12.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, John Park <john.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Plan & Success Criteria — Tech impact and estimate

Hi all — quick technical readout based on the reranking addition: 

Assessment:
- Reranking will increase average sequence length (queries + candidates) and number of forward passes per query. Expect ~25-35% more GPU time depending on candidate set size; I used 10 candidates in the estimate.
- To mitigate cost/latency impact we recommend:
  * Quantize the model to int8 (no expected accuracy hit for this workload),
  * Enable aggressive batching for rerank scoring with a 50ms latency tail target,
  * Turn on prefix caching for shared candidate encodings where appropriate.

Estimate:
- SE setup: 2 full days (Michael to run data transform + harness).
- Infra: +30% GPU hours during the trial window (subject to change on final candidate set size).
- Timeline impact: +7 days to evaluation completion (matches Marissa's proposal).

I will author a short appendix for POC-SOW-v1.1 listing these optimizations and the assumptions I used. If Nimbus can provide a sample of the candidate sizes we can tighten the estimate.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
